title: Move Customers does not change the customer in QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A (made for this test), due 20 days after the invoice date, is held only by customer A (made for this test), who is in QuickBooks with terms term A.
  • Make sure Net 45 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. In QuickBooks, open the customer A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The window opens.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows Net 45.

Step 4:

  • The toast "1 customer moved to Net 45." shows.

Step 5:

  • Its terms still read term A: no customer update was sent.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11677 (Story 8, QuickBooks sync - credit terms)

  • S8-R6: “Changing a customer's term in ShopView, by Edit Customer or by Move Customers (Story 4: Move Customers), does not change the customer record in QuickBooks, exactly as an Edit Customer save does not today. The QuickBooks customer keeps the term it was created with; new invoices still carry the right term.”
  • S4-R12: “Each moved customer gets the new term (and, under S4-R16, a $0 credit limit) and the S4-R11 note. AccountingHub receives the same customer update an Edit Customer save sends. The customer's other fields are not re-checked, so a customer with incomplete details still moves. No customer update is sent to QuickBooks (S8-R6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
